key_difference: (B) fixes the hang with a small destructor in RunFunctionTaskBase that cancels and finishes an unfinished promise; (D) instead adds a new exported QtCore guard-runnable mechanism, including a new member on the public QFutureInterfaceBase, and also rewires ThreadEngine's start paths, so it runs the discarded engine's run() synchronously inside QThreadPool::clear(), which widens the API/ABI surface and risks reentrancy that (B) avoids.
